How Often Should You Service Your RO Water Purifier?

Maintenance January 15, 2025

Your RO water purifier is one of the most important appliances in your home. It ensures your family gets clean, safe drinking water every day. But like any machine, it needs regular servicing to keep working at its best. So how often should you actually service it?

General Service Schedule

For most homes in Bangalore, we recommend servicing your RO water purifier every 3 to 4 months. This includes a basic checkup, cleaning of internal parts, and inspection of filters. If your water source has high TDS or hard water, you may need to service it more often — every 2 months.

Filter Replacement Timeline

Different filters have different lifespans. Here is a quick guide:

  • Sediment Filter — Every 6 months
  • Carbon Filter — Every 6 to 9 months
  • RO Membrane — Every 18 to 24 months
  • UV Lamp — Every 12 months
  • Post-Carbon Filter — Every 12 months

Signs Your RO Needs Immediate Service

Do not wait for the scheduled service if you notice any of these signs:

  • Change in taste or smell of water
  • Low water flow from the tap
  • Unusual noise from the motor
  • Water leakage around the purifier
  • Frequent on-off cycling of the motor

Benefits of Regular Servicing

Regular maintenance keeps your RO running efficiently and extends its lifespan by several years. It also ensures that your water is free from harmful contaminants and bacteria. Plus, timely servicing saves you from costly repairs later — small issues caught early are cheap to fix.
